lesson.guided_practice:
PRACTISE BEFORE READING THE FEEDBACK
Plan pattern, setting and rule you will not break (no copying sacred/restricted stories).

FEEDBACK
Pattern + place + original cast; stay fictional and respectful.

CHECK
Presenting an invented tale as a real cultural tradition is dishonest.
lesson.independent_task:
INDEPENDENT EVIDENCE
Write a 180–220 word original folktale-style story with a clear pattern and setting. Add a note that it is fictional, not a traditional cultural text.

Write a short reflection describing one specific revision you made and why.
lesson.learning_intention: Writing a folktale-style story uses a familiar pattern with original characters and a clear setting, without copying a living culture’s restricted stories.
lesson.offline_alternative: Use paper and pencil to complete the original task, then retain a photograph or short parent observation as evidence.
lesson.parent_notes:
Parent: Marking guidance for the independent task: Write a 180–220 word original folktale-style story with a clear pattern and setting. Add a note that it is fictional, not a traditional cultural text. Accept equivalent original responses that show the same skill.

Parent: Written model 1: Sample: original example using folktale on new material; names a specific word, source or choice and explains its effect.

Parent: Written model 2: Sample error: Presenting an invented tale as a real cultural tradition is dishonest.. Correction: Pattern + place + original cast;. Why it helps the audience is stated.

Parent: Likely misconception: Presenting an invented tale as a real cultural tradition is dishonest. Keep sample answers out of the child role.

Parent: Short-answer focus 1: Produce a fresh example demonstrating folktale on new material (not the worked model). Explain the particular words, sources or choices that make it work.

Parent: Short-answer focus 2: Name one likely error with folktale, correct it, and explain why the correction helps a reader or audience.

Parent: Marking notes: Accept original work about folktale with a specific supporting detail. Reject copied model wording with no new material. / Accept a misconception, a correction, and a purpose-linked reason for folktale. Reject corrections that do not change the inaccurate idea..

teach_steps.explain:
Writing a folktale-style story uses a familiar pattern with original characters and a clear setting, without copying a living culture’s restricted stories.

WHY IT MATTERS
This helps the learner make decisions based on specific language evidence, rather than guess or copy someone else. Keep the meaning accurate and explain the choice.
